### prCliFinish

Prints a gate's report and answers its exit code: 0 when it passed, 1 when
it found a problem, 2 when it could not run.

```ts
function prCliFinish(
  command: string,
  result: Result<PrReport, string>,
  format: string,
): i32
```

<scalar-field name="command" type="string" required>

the command, for an error: "spec frozen"

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="result" type="Result&lt;PrReport, string&gt;" required>

the report, or why the gate could not run

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="format" type="string" required>

text, markdown or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="i32">

the exit code

</scalar-field>
